name: hostdeck
description: HostDeck Infrastructure OS 1.4.6: corrige o runtime Next.js no instalador Electron, preserva dependências standalone via runtime_modules e adiciona validação de boot.

scripts.build: npm run clean && next build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && cross-env HOSTDECK_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish:win: npm run build && cross-env HOSTDECK_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish always
scripts.desktop:publish:linux: npm run build && cross-env HOSTDECK_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish always
scripts.desktop:publish:mac: npm run build && cross-env HOSTDECK_RELEASE=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish always
